page: Microsoft Azure M176bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processors with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The configuration features 176 vCPUs derived from 88 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 3892.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 22.11 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is provided via an integrated 8192 GB SSD. The hypervisor layer is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V.

Benchmark evaluations place this server in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 141597.52 and a PassMark CPU score of 117203.87. Memory subsystem performance is highly competitive, registering top-tier read-only small block cached bandwidth of 11574.6 GB/sec and uncached large block write bandwidth of 186.0 GB/sec. Single-core performance is moderately lower, with stress-ng single-core and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the average tier. However, multi-threaded operations like bzip3 decompression and PassMark database operations achieve top-tier status.

Given the massive memory footprint and high-density compute resources, this server represents a high-resource hardware class designed for enterprise-scale workloads. The qualitative cost efficiency is characterized by a high ratio of memory to vCPU, making it suitable for memory-bound applications where provisioning separate compute nodes would introduce latency. The presence of advanced instruction sets, such as Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512, supports specialized tasks like large language model inference, where it achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds of 39.78 tokens/second on 70B models. The server is suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory data stores like Redis, heavy multi-threaded data processing, and enterprise ERP systems.
description: Microsoft Azure M176bds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized server from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features 176 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8473C processors at 4.0 GHz, 3892.0 GB of RAM, and an 8192 GB local SSD. This hardware configuration delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 141597.52 and uncached read bandwidth reaching 432.05 GB/sec. While single-core benchmarks sit in the average tier, the server excels in multi-threaded workloads, database operations, and Redis SET transactions, where it processes 169.15 million operations per second. It is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, and heavy data processing.
